## Playlists, offline and playback
- **Offline for every list:** playlists, imported playlists, Liked songs and Spotify playlists can be made available offline in the phone and computer app (download button next to the list). Songs from Spotify & co. are fetched whole through your server
- **Edit like Spotify (phone):** the edit mode shows the cover and name on top, songs with a minus and a handle below. The list scrolls, sorting glides smoothly and scrolls along at the edges. The hint text is gone
- **Phone and computer:** on the phone there is an edit mode and "Edit details", on the computer only "Edit details" (songs are dragged right in the list)
- **Edit details:** no more three dots on the picture, a pencil badge shows that it can be changed, no hint text at the bottom
- **Liked songs can be edited:** own picture, name and description
- **Play button pauses:** the big play button of a playlist or of "Mix for you" turns into pause while that list plays and pauses it, instead of starting again
- **Play from every playlist:** songs from other platforms that were greyed out play now, found on YouTube like on Home
- **Delete your own songs:** "Delete from server" in the song menu, only for your own music files, with a confirmation
- **Preload only what is new:** a list that was preloaded only loads the songs added since. Settings → Playback → "Always preload everything" loads the whole list each time. Preloading steps aside while a song starts, so playback no longer stutters or stops in the background
- **Visualizer in sync:** it waits for Bluetooth headphones automatically and reacts faster. Settings → Visualizer → Delay to fine-tune it
- **Player bar stays:** after the phone app reloads while music keeps playing, the bar and the song come back
- **Profile:** "Add bio" is gone, the bio is a field in "Edit profile"
- **Platform logos** can be switched off in the settings
- **Song links in Discord:** shared links show the song name, artist and cover as a preview
- **Hand cursor** on every slider

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
